title: Design System: Gira Clothing — Admin Dashboard

label.purpose: Stat-card labels, chip text, form labels, uppercase.

mono.purpose: Money, unit counts, SKUs — anything reconciled against a receipt.

shadows.name: nb-shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: The single most important surface per screen; pressable-card hover.

shadows.name: nb-shadow-pressed
shadows.purpose: Active/pressed state — shadow collapses to zero.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for press/hover state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 16px; min-height: 38px; background: var(--color-brand); color: var(--color-text-inverse); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 0 var(--color-ink); transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-hover); transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 0 var(--color-ink); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: KPI tile: uppercase label, mono value, optional icon and footnote.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: var(--color-surface); border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 var(--color-ink); padding: 16px; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--color-text-secondary); margin: 0; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 8px 0 0; } .ds-stat-foot { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-text-secondary); margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: Stat Card — Accented
components.description: The single highlighted KPI per screen; same shape as Stat Card with brand-subtle fill.
components.css: .ds-stat-card-accent { background: var(--color-brand-subtle); border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 var(--color-ink); padding: 16px; } .ds-stat-card-accent .ds-stat-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--color-text-secondary); margin: 0; } .ds-stat-card-accent .ds-stat-value { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 8px 0 0; } .ds-stat-card-accent .ds-stat-value small { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text-muted); margin-left: 4px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Order-status indicator: flat pastel fill, ink border, dark text — never white text on saturated fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-ink); background: var(--status-shipped); color: var(--color-text-primary); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field: ink border, no inset shadow, focus shifts border to the focus blue.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-focus); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation link; active state uses brand-subtle fill and bold weight, never an underline or stripe.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text-secondary); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--color-brand-subtle); color: var(--color-text-primary); font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: This is not a marketing surface, it is the instrument panel an operations team stares at during a shift: order queues, stock levels, notification failures. Every choice serves speed of reading over decoration. The system borrows its vocabulary from neobrutalism on purpose, not as a trend but as a literal metaphor: solid ink borders and hard offset shadows read like a printed control panel, something built rather than styled, exactly right for a store that sells physical printed apparel. It explicitly rejects the generic SaaS-dashboard look: no glassmorphism, no purple-to-blue gradients, no hairline 1px borders that vanish at a glance, no gradient-text hero metrics. Neutrals are never truly grey; every surface is tinted toward the brand hue (chroma 0.003–0.02) so the whole UI reads as one material, not a stack of disconnected panels.
keyCharacteristics: Hard 2px ink borders and flat offset shadows instead of blur/opacity for depth.
One accent color used sparingly, reserved for exactly one KPI per screen.
Status conveyed by a wide, deliberately non-semantic palette of nine order-status hues, always paired with an ink border and dark text.
Zero decorative motion; state feedback only, translated into shadow offset, not scale or blur.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: --color-brand appears on at most one stat card and interactive primary actions per screen. A second highlighted tile on the same screen is always a bug, not a design choice.

rules.name: The Nine-Hue Status Rule
rules.body: Order and shipment statuses each get their own hue from a wayfinding palette, always with an ink border and dark text. A status is never conveyed by fill color alone.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any value the user might reconcile against a receipt or a shipping label renders in the mono font. Everything else is sans.

rules.name: The Press-Into-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements never scale on press. They translate a couple of pixels toward their own shadow, which shrinks to zero at active. motion-reduce disables the translate but the shadow itself never disappears.

dos: Do keep every color literal inside tokens.css; components read tokens, never inline hex or oklch values.
Do use the largest shadow for at most one surface per screen, the thing that most needs to interrupt the reader.
Do render money and unit counts in the mono font, always.
Do draw every state explicitly (empty, error, zero), never leave a silent gap where data should be.
donts: Don't use glassmorphism, blur, or translucency anywhere except the scrim behind a mobile drawer.
Don't use gradients anywhere except the zero-value chart-bar hatch pattern, which is a texture, not a decoration.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe on a card or list row.
Don't accent more than one stat card per screen.
Don't nest a card inside another card.
